Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 13 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 31 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
